name: openreview-decision-classification-benchmark
description: A dataset for predicting OpenReview paper decisions (e.g., accept/reject) from submission content and metadata. It measures a model's capability to perform binary classification based on paper text, authorship, and other review-related signals. The benchmark is intended to support research on automated peer-review decision prediction and related fairness and interpretability analyses.
evaluation_method: accuracy (and often F1 to account for class imbalance)
reputation: A niche dataset used in research on peer-review prediction with limited but growing adoption in related fairness and NLP studies.
